message.content: Helios speaks highly of several games, but he specifically calls "The Last of Us" a "masterpiece" due to its ability to make players feel deeply connected to the characters. He notes that the character growth and moral dilemmas in the game are top-notch, with Joel and Ellie's relationship serving as a roller coaster of love, loss, and difficult choices. This makes the experience feel very real and emotionally resonant.
